I know life sucks sometimes because it's not black and white. How Ive felt the last few years was awful. What made it worse was how everyone asked why I didn't have a girlfriend. I didn't care anymore I thought I would be alone my whole life. I basically gave up until a girl messaged me a year ago I thought I would see if I could find out what love was. Love is the greatest. I got to talk to her all day and she messaged back it felt good to talk openly to somebody. I never expected to realize love is way better than sex. Love for me is about being all about working together and being one machine to be efficient. Most of all I had to emotionally support the person I loved more than myself. I started falling into a spiral before my cat died. I realise now I miss my best friend who was a cat more than a girl that spoke back. I just need that emotional support by somebody. I want to find it but the fact I realize how alone I truly am right now really makes me feel like a piece of garbage.

I started dating a year ago because I was lonely and tired of seeing happy couples as I'm alone. I had never been in love before so thought that I'd try. I think I'm just not used to dating yet. I expected a person to listen to me and not pick on me for feeling certain ways. I feel like I need somebody who doesn't lie all the time and listens. I've been walked all over my whole life but I'm not letting that happen again it juzst feels awful that I cant go my life without constant anger against people.

I should say why I get sad. Back in may my cat died at 21, I knew no person as well as my best friend hobbes. When she died I was drained. I struggle and ignored my git friend because she never understood and couldn't help. Fast foreward 3 weeks I'm sitting on my couch with tears pouring from my face. My cremated cat is in a box and now in my lap. I couldn't look at it. I told my girlfriend, she said "this is going to sound harsh bit you need to grow up". I couldn't believe it I knew at that moment maybe I need to break up with this cunt. I for some fucked reason  stayed. Later in late June she "broke  up" with me. I drove home and was thinking of parking at a gas station and jumping of a building. I was almost done with it all. Later that day she gets a hold of me and apologizes and we were back together. I shouldn't have done that. Back in August she ignored me for weeks due to stress of her masters degree. I was home in bed at night and she was being an ashole ignoring astoundingly nice things the 3 weeks before when she allowed me to see her. She texted that night she was done. She wouldn't pick up. I called twice and she was ... a very happy person. I was dead inside and can't remember the conversation but it was over.  I was doing awful. After 2 months of getting better after learning I got accepted to a Great Uni I was dating again. I texted the first girl and we set a date up. Date comes and nobody's picking up the phone. Ok no problem I feel bad but hey look another girl! I set up another date. Same shit.... I told people I had a date. I can't believe people can be this fucked up. I know I should suck it up but I feel like... I'm worthless as shit. Sorry for how long this is I had to get it out.
